general.deleteBody: Removes the workspace with all its projects, tasks, files and chat. This cannot be undone.
general.deleteOwnersOnly: Only the owner can delete the workspace.
general.confirmBody: Every project, task, file and conversation in it will be gone for good.

labels.removeBody: It is removed from every task that has it.

readOnly: You can look around, but only workspace administrators can change these settings.

gate.title: This part is switched off
gate.description: An administrator turned off {{feature}} for this workspace.

features.cardDescription: A module that is off disappears from the menu for everyone. Nothing is deleted; switch it on again to get it back.

chat.description: Channels, direct messages and conversations on tasks.

integrations.description: Google Calendar, GitHub and other connections.

inviteBy.title: Who can invite
inviteBy.description: Members can invite only up to their own role.

days.title: Invitation lifetime
days.description: After this many days an invitation link stops working.

domains.title: Allowed email domains
domains.description: Only addresses of these domains can be invited, for example company.com. Leave empty to allow any.

access.peopleDescription: Invite, change roles or remove members.

rules.tasksDescription: Defaults for new tasks and how the calendar looks.

priority.title: Default priority
priority.description: Used when a new task is created without one.

dueDate.title: Require a due date
dueDate.description: New tasks cannot be created without a due date.

rules.chatDescription: Rules for channels and notifying many people at once.

audit.emptyHint: Changes to settings, roles and invitations will be listed here.
audit.adminsOnly: Only administrators can see the audit log.

email.testQueued: Test email queued. It appears below in a few seconds.
email.adminsOnly: Only administrators can see email delivery.
email.capturingTitle: Emails are not reaching real inboxes
email.capturingBody: This server sends email to a test inbox (such as Mailpit), so invitations, reminders and password resets are collected there and never delivered. Connect a real provider below, then restart the API and worker.
email.queueBody_one: {{count}} email is waiting to be sent. If this number does not go down, the background worker is not running.
email.queueBody_other: {{count}} emails are waiting to be sent. If this number does not go down, the background worker is not running.
email.queueHint: Waiting now, and failed for good in the last 7 days.
email.recentDescription: Emails to people of this workspace, newest first.
email.none: No emails yet. Send a test email to see how it goes.
email.setupDescription: Set these in the server's .env file (secrets stay out of the browser).
email.setupAfter: Then run: docker compose up -d api worker. Use “Send me a test email” to check.
